title: Workspace owner canonical brand create lifecycle

phases.objective: Allow an authenticated workspace owner/admin to create or idempotently reuse a canonical brand identity and atomically establish explicit tenant authority plus a creator admin grant, without granting all workspace members access or claiming Brand Core readiness prematurely.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The owner/admin authority is revalidated under lock inside the mutation transaction, the brand identity is deterministically resolved or created, an explicit active tenant_brand_links authority row exists, the creator has an active brand admin grant, exact readbacks succeed, and a retry reuses the same tenant brand identity.
steps: Normalize the requested display name with Unicode NFKC, trimmed collapsed whitespace, and case-insensitive identity matching.
Derive a deterministic tenant-scoped target key so equivalent names in the same workspace converge while the same display name in another tenant cannot collide.
Revalidate the signed-in actor as exactly one active owner/admin membership of the active tenant using a locking read inside the transaction.
Reuse exactly one existing active tenant-linked canonical brand with the same normalized identity, otherwise resolve/create exactly one active global brands row using the deterministic target key.
Create or repair an active tenant_brand_links row with explicit workspace_owner_brand_create provenance rather than upgrading historical projection fallback into authority.
Create or repair an active workspace_resource_grants brand/admin grant for the creator using the existing owner_assignment source plus bounded metadata provenance.
Read back the active tenant link and creator grant before commit and return the existing or newly created brand identity without secrets.
Report Brand Core profile setup as a next step unless canonical brand_core_ready is true-like; do not invent readiness or create Brand Core assets in this slice.
assertions: A non-owner/admin or missing/inactive workspace membership fails closed before any brand, tenant-link, or creator-grant mutation.
Equivalent brand names within one tenant are idempotent and do not create a second global brand row.
The same display name in different tenants derives different workspace-scoped canonical target keys.
The creator receives only an explicit brand admin grant; brand creation does not grant all workspace members brand access.
tenant_brand_links uses link_source=workspace_owner_brand_create and authority_implied=true metadata rather than tenant_metadata_brand_key projection provenance.
workspace_resource_grants uses its existing owner_assignment source enum and metadata reason workspace_brand_create; no schema extension is required.
The route owns begin/commit/rollback and the service performs all authority, canonical identity, link, grant, and readback operations on that same connection.
No Migration Apply, live SQL mutation, Production/provider mutation, deployment, credential/secret access, force push, or external send occurs in CI.
